text: Good morning. Have you had a chance to look at the course catalog for next semester? Yes, I have picked two courses, but I am not sure what to choose for my third. What are you leaning toward? Your degree still requires one more writing course and one science elective. In that case, I would like to take the writing course now and save the science elective for later. That works. The academic writing course fills up quickly, so you should register as soon as enrollment opens. Thanks for the warning. I will register on the first day so I do not lose my place. Before registering, check that the writing seminar does not clash with your other classes. I will compare the seminar time with my existing schedule. If it is full, join the waiting list and email me. We can discuss a backup. I will join the waiting list and contact you about another option.
